limits: Do not merge percentage changes across the three datasets.
Complete simulation rate includes input preparation, validation, diagnostic polls, resource counter reads and bookkeeping; renderer open, endpoint capture and close are separate.
Pipeline rate is apply-to-fresh throughput, not complete simulation or consumer FPS.
OFF/DEEP is one sequential observation, not isolated causal overhead.
Frame/self wall includes cross-thread resource waits; neither exclusive CPU nor pure GPU busy time; never add Frame and ResourcePlan.
Per-frame native statistics include zero-work frames; per-event distributions have different denominators. P95=0 per frame does not erase sparse refresh tails.
GetThreadTimes observations are quantized around 15.625ms; a zero sample does not mean exact zero CPU cost.
Missing older-runtime work counters are unavailable, not zero; no count inference from mesh population.
The short old/current runtime comparison includes accumulated bridge changes and is not a per-change ablation of the latest fixes.
Historical fast20 lacks complete-simulation timing: do not reconstruct it by adding unrelated mean intervals.
Upstream internal registry/reindex, scene-table upload granularity, exact-size TLAS and complete material-definition import gaps remain.
